brief: Choose a feasible response to a deficit without inventing income or assuming borrowing is affordable.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Respond to a real deficit"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Responde a un déficit real"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Responda a um déficit real"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Choose a feasible response to a deficit without inventing income or assuming borrowing is affordable.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Choose a response supported by the stated constraints and confirmed facts.
instruction.misconception: Closing a budget gap with imagined income, impossible cuts or borrowing whose repayment is unexamined.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: A deficit needs a feasible change. Check what can change, its cost, and when the change takes effect.
This change removes a stated avoidable cost without an added fee.
Receiving a loan does not establish capacity to repay it.
Pending support is not available money at the deadline.
A later saving can coexist with an unaffordable upfront cost.
A discussion can clarify options without guaranteeing a changed obligation.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A deficit needs a feasible change. Check what can change, its cost, and when the change takes effect.

pt-BR.line: Um déficit exige uma mudança viável. Confira o que pode mudar, seu custo e quando terá efeito.

en-US.scene: A deficit exists; an unused subscription can be canceled immediately without fees.

options.label: Delete a necessary bill from records

help: Use an available option rather than an invented receipt.

feedback.met: This change removes a stated avoidable cost without an added fee.

options.label: Borrar una cuenta necesaria del registro
Suponer un aumento salarial sin confirmar

help: Usa una opción disponible sin inventar entradas.

Supor um aumento salarial não confirmado

en-US.scene: A loan covers today’s gap; repayment amounts and dates are unknown.

options.label: Yes, a loan removes future costs
No, check repayment against the plan

help: Include repayment obligations before judging the proposal.

No, compara pagos con el plan
Sí, recibir demuestra capacidad de pago
